testcase.name: A placed circle lies in the plane normal to the rotated +Y, at distance scale * r from the translation, and runs counter-clockwise about that normal (sections 3, 5)
Orientation by Frame: Quat.fromFrame(Frame.fromHeading(...)) places a circle facing a heading, without new orientation types (sections 3, 9)
Validation: curve and pose are required; transformed(pose) is a PosedCurve (section 3)
Derivatives transform as directions scaled by the pose scale: they match finite differences of the placed points (section 3)
